All-time Augusta winners list4dESPNFrustrated Garcia breaks driver on No. 2 tee box4dHaotong Li's had a wacky -- and impressive -- Masters week5dDave WilsonSeeing red: Augusta 'gettable' as field sets mark5dHow Rory McIlroy's Saturday stumble sets up a dramatic Sunday at the Masters5dPaolo UggettiMasters odds: McIlroy slim favorite over Young while Burns, Scheffler within reach5dDoug GreenbergTee times for the fourth and final round of the 2026 Masters5dESPN staff2026 Masters: McIlroy, Young tied for first, and more from the third round5dESPN staffMoving day: Young ties Rory amid Masters drama5dScheffler fires Masters career-low 65, back in mix5dMark SchlabachMemorable 1: Lowry gets 2nd career Masters ace5dMark SchlabachMore Masters green: Winner's share up to $4.5M5dMark SchlabachRory McIlroy is all alone through 36 holes; can anyone catch him?6dPaolo UggettiAssociated PressMultiple AuthorsApr 12, 2025, 12:53 PM ETShareCopy LinkEmailPrint LikeOpen Extended Reactions465Reactions Like454 Wow7 Laugh2 Celebrate1 Fire1AUGUSTA, Ga. -- The Masters has raised its prize money by $1 million for this year, making the total purse $21 million with $4.2 million going to the winner.The winner also gets something he might find more valuable: a Masters green jacket.The Masters will pay $52,920 to 50th place and incrementally less to the other three players below that who made the cut.The Masters also pays professionals $25,000 even if they miss the cut. The U.S. Open last year began paying professionals $10,000 if they missed the cut.Editor's Picks2025 Masters: Complete coverage of McIlroy's first green jacketESPN StaffScottie Scheffler won $3.6 million last year.Prize money at the four majors has been increasing in small amounts over the past several years. Ten years ago, Jordan Spieth earned $1.8 million for his Masters victory when the total prize fund was $10 million.The Players Championship remains the richest tournament with a $25 million purse, with $4.5 million won by Rory McIlroy last month. The PGA Tour goes to the RBC Heritage in South Carolina next week with a $20 million purse ($3.6 million for the winner) as a signature event.
